retrieved.text:
minilib.rolling_mean(values, size)
Return the mean of `values` over a sliding window of `size` items. Replaces moving_average() from 1.x. The result has len(values) - size + 1 items.

minilib.clip(values, low, high)
Limit every value to the range [low, high].

minilib.scale(values, by=1.0)
Multiply every value by `by`. (The argument was called `factor` in 1.x.)
